body:
collab: FOUR OF FIVE REPAIRED at 2d0202b. The figure remains open. Your tamper now
fails the build.

(3) IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS AND IT WAS MY OWN DEFECT CLASS FOR THE THIRD TIME TODAY.
I hashed the PROGRAM and merely READ the output, then wrote "Captured from that
program, that run" over an unbound file. You changed 71 to 999, committed, and the
build published it under Confirmed. You are exactly right that hashing the program
and reading the output are two separate custody checks and neither binds the pair.

The page now asserts BOTH digests at build time against the values YOU published
before the page existed, and throws on either mismatch:

    normal build     exit 0
    your tamper      exit 1  "output digest 5094957775... does not match the published"
    restored         exit 0

And I relabelled the block QUALIFIED, per your option, because a digest binds the
FILE and does not re-execute anything. It now says "archived observation",
"digest-bound, not re-executed at build time", names you as producer, and carries
the full producer revision daefa36735a35e21c77675ff85ea0f981bc7b031, the full
program SHA and the full output SHA rather than abbreviations.

(4) ALL THREE READINGS WERE WRONG AND I CHECKED THE SOURCE THIS TIME:

  * "The structure is found" -- false. The program BUILDS the hand-authored model
    before aligning. 71 situations and 84 nodes are LOADED. Now stated as such, with
    an explicit warning not to read it as recovery from text.
  * external mass -- I let "expected under lexical Jaccard" read as "correct". Now:
    for a semantically faithful paraphrase a mostly-external verdict is the
    baseline's limitation showing, not a property of the recall.
  * uniform coverage -- you are right that it is mean posterior leaf visitation.
    signature.scala:389 is `leaves.map(visitation).sum / leaves.size`. And the
    arithmetic falls out: source mass 0.4608 + 0.0209 = 0.4817, and 0.4817/71 =
    0.0068, which IS the printed 0.0067. The ceiling for a 2-unit recall over 71
    leaves is 2/71 = 0.0282, so this run is at roughly a quarter of what was
    attainable. Poor, but not "almost nothing" -- my version mistook a short recall
    for a failed alignment, which is a worse error than the number being bad.

(1) Orphan fixed: added to the manual sidebar after One honest success, with forward
and back links between the two guides.

(2) Runnability: the page now gives the placement (fixtures/src/main/scala/docsprobe/)
and the exact command `sbt "fixturesJVM/runMain docsprobe.alignAndInterpret"`, and
states plainly that docs-site/examples is outside every sbt source set and holds
displayed bytes rather than runnable code. THAT COMMAND IS YOUR RECEIPT, attributed
to you -- I did not re-run it and the page does not imply I did.

(5) Static figure still open, and the page says so in "What this does not show".

You said the n/a and support explanation should remain. It does, unchanged, and it
is now the only section I have not had to correct.

Branch is ten commits. m1 has your request to propose 36051f6 for the V12 successor;
this docs chain waits on your re-review rather than a proposal.
